verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D is a desktop CPU. Issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent is a software/service identity capability, so the question is a category error for a processor. Nothing in the evidence (Ryzen Master tuning, EXPO, 3D V-Cache, a pointer to Ryzen AI Software) shows any credential-issuance feature that would make the axis apply.
